meta.name: agent-evaluation
meta.description: Testing and benchmarking LLM agents including behavioral testing, capability assessment, reliability metrics, and production monitoring—where even top agents achieve less than 50% on real-world benchmarks Use when: agent testing, agent evaluation, benchmark agents, agent reliability, test agent.

copy.tagline: 测试和评估LLM智能体的行为与可靠性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要系统化测试和评估LLM智能体的性能与可靠性
copy.tagline_en: Test and benchmark LLM agents for behavior and reliability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically test and evaluate LLM agent performance and reliability

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会像一位质量工程师，帮你测试和评估 AI 代理（agent）的行为、能力、可靠性，并监控生产环境中的表现。它会设计测试框架，发现代理在真实场景中的问题。
howto.when: 当你需要测试、评估或基准测试 AI 代理，或者想了解代理的可靠性时触发。

say.text: 帮我测试这个客服代理的可靠性。
say.note: Claude 会设计可靠性测试并运行。

say.text: 评估一下我的代理在基准测试中的表现。
say.note: Claude 会进行基准测试并分析结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a quality engineer to test and evaluate LLM agents, including behavioral testing, capability assessment, reliability metrics, and production monitoring. It designs evaluation frameworks to catch issues before production.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to test, evaluate, or benchmark LLM agents, or assess agent reliability.

say_en.text: Test the reliability of this customer service agent.
say_en.note: Claude will design and run reliability tests.

say_en.text: Evaluate my agent's performance on benchmarks.
say_en.note: Claude will run benchmarks and analyze results.
